title: Closing Programme Feedback
subtitle: Shaping Future-Ready Graduates: T-Shaped Learning, Academic Rigour and Academic Transformation (28–30 Sept 2026)
instructions: This closing feedback takes about 8–10 minutes. It is the same form for Participants, the QIP Coordinator and Resource Persons — answer from your own vantage point on the programme. Your name and role are recorded so the QIP Coordinator can follow up if needed, but individual answers are seen only by you and the App Admin; everyone else sees only the combined, anonymised summary in Analytics & Reports.

items.text: This programme deepened my understanding of vertical disciplinary depth.
This programme deepened my understanding of horizontal breadth and interdisciplinary connections.
I can now explain the 70:30 (depth : breadth) principle to a colleague.
I have a clearer picture of where my own department currently sits on the depth-vs-breadth spectrum.
I am confident applying at least one of Bloom's Revised Taxonomy, Webb's Depth of Knowledge, or the Cognitive Rigour Matrix as a diagnostic tool.
Day 1 sessions — Foundations: The T-Shaped Graduate, Academic Rigour and Departmental Diagnosis
Day 2 sessions — Hands-On Curriculum Redesign I: From Higher-Order Thinking to Depth of Knowledge
Day 3 sessions — Hands-On Curriculum Redesign II: Vertical Progression, Authentic Assessment and Institutionalising Change
Pacing and time management across the three days
Clarity and usefulness of handouts / working documents
